title: Sea Dragon Pirate Cruise
specs: Stay within half a mile from shore for better sights
Captain tries to find dolphins but sightings not guaranteed
Infants under 12 months require a ticket for US Coast Guard passenger count
Wheelchairs allowed; ramp accommodates standard width chairs; restrooms not wheelchair accessible
blurb: Guests board the Sea Dragon, a modern-day replica pirate ship, for a sightseeing cruise near shore lasting about 2 hours. The cruise includes pirate-themed activities for kids such as sword fighting, swabbing the deck, firing a kid cannon, treasure hunts, face painting, and a pirate dance party. The ship offers drinks and snacks for purchase and aims to find dolphins and provide a fun family experience.
extraNote: Smoking allowed briefly at halfway point on back of top deck with ashtrays
